<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="p">
  <state id="p">
    <initial>
      <transition event="boot" cond="true" target="c"/>
    </initial>
    <state id="c">
      <transition event="go" target="d"/>
    </state>
    <final id="d"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

notes: default entry is unconditional: SCXML 3.6.2 says the initial transition "MUST NOT contain 'cond' or 'event' attributes" and must name a target
